with due as (select tenant_id,inbox_id from integration_inbox where ((status in ('VERIFIED','STALE_CLAIM')) or (status='FAILED_RETRYABLE' and next_retry_at<=#{now})) and (lease_until is null or lease_until<=#{now}) order by coalesce(next_retry_at,received_at),received_at for update skip locked limit #{limit}) update integration_inbox i set status='PROCESSING',claim_owner=#{workerId},claim_token_hash=md5(#{claimTokenHash}||':'||i.inbox_id),claimed_at=#{now},lease_until=#{leaseUntil},processing_attempt_id=#{processingAttemptId}||':'||i.inbox_id,last_error_code=null,last_error_message=null,row_version=i.row_version+1 from due where i.tenant_id=due.tenant_id and i.inbox_id=due.inbox_id returning i.*
mapper.update: with stale as (select tenant_id,inbox_id from integration_inbox where status='PROCESSING' and lease_until<=#{now} order by lease_until for update skip locked limit #{limit}) update integration_inbox i set status='STALE_CLAIM',claim_owner=null,claim_token_hash=null,claimed_at=null,lease_until=null,processing_attempt_id=null,last_error_code='WEBHOOK_CLAIM_LEASE_EXPIRED',last_error_message='Webhook processing claim expired and was released for recovery.',row_version=i.row_version+1 from stale where i.tenant_id=stale.tenant_id and i.inbox_id=stale.inbox_id
